'''October 2000 Orland Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Orland Park, Illinois on 29 October 2000. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1399">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-orland-park-illinois-10-29-00d1399/ orland-park-illinois-10-29-00], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 29 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-29-orland-park-illinois-10-29-00d1399/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Orland Park, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
